title: Windy local discovery registry (~/.windy/surfaces.json), v1
$comment: ADR-060 §3.8 — one read, every knob. Every Class D product writes its entry at startup and removes it on clean shutdown. File mode 0600. Readers PROBE BEFORE TRUST: an entry is believed only after its surface's get_health answers; a dead port is stale, not gospel. Cloud discovery is NOT this file — it is one account-server query keyed by EPT.

contract.$comment: which control contract this surface speaks, e.g. control.mcp.v1

http.$comment: native transport base — loopback ONLY in this file, by schema

mcp.$comment: how an MCP client attaches, e.g. 'stdio:npx windy-talk-mcp' or a streamable-http URL

token_path.$comment: where the per-install bearer token lives (0600). Absent = surface predates token auth.

health.$comment: how a reader probes liveness before trusting this entry

pid.$comment: optional; helps readers reap stale entries
